notes.title: The game is officially released
notes.content:
[h3][b]ːsteamhappyːI’m the game developer, and I’m so happy to have come this far. Yay yay yay!ːsteamhappyː[/b][/h3]

This is the official version of the game, and you can experience most of its gameplay. There will be occasional updates in the future to enrich the game’s content and features.

I’ll be keeping an eye on the game community, and feel free to leave comments!
